primitives.name: Global Longitudinal Strain
primitives.verbatim_quote: Echocardiographic indices included global longitudinal strain (GLS), global work efficiency (GWE), global wasted work (GWW), and myocardial performance index (MPI).
primitives.assumptions: Linear elastic deformation of myocardial fibers under cyclic loading.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Resting baseline in trained athletes shows minimal responsiveness to acute changes.

layer2.mapping: GLS quantifies myocardial deformation efficiency, enabling GSI probabilistic inference on performance class.

primitives.name: Global Work Efficiency
primitives.verbatim_quote: Global Work Efficiency (GWE) is defined as the ratio of constructive myocardial work to total myocardial work, whereas Global Wasted Work (GWW) represents myocardial work that does not contribute to effective ventricular ejection.
primitives.assumptions: Work is computed from pressure-strain loops under brachial blood pressure calibration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High GWE correlates with superior anaerobic power and reduced reaction time.

layer2.mapping: GWE maps to cardiac mechanical efficiency, enabling GSE state transitions in performance prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Pressure-strain loop analysis from speckletracking echocardiography.

GLS reflects myocardial deformation, GWE quantifies effective mechanical work, and MPI integrates systolic and diastolic function. These metrics form a mathematical framework where cardiac strain efficiency directly influences anaerobic power and neuromotor coordination. The dual nature of GWE—separating constructive from wasted work—enables precise modeling of cardiac output optimization. MPI's inverse relationship with performance outcomes indicates its role in identifying suboptimal cardiac dynamics. The framework assumes linear elasticity of myocardial tissue and consistent pressure-strain coupling under physiological stress. Failure modes include measurement variability in resting GLS among trained athletes and potential confounding by anthropometric factors. The model's validity hinges on longitudinal validation to confirm predictive utility over time.
